name: sim
summary: run simulated BMCs for tests: serve one, or a fleet with a virtual machine behind each

subcommands.name: serve
subcommands.summary: serve one simulated BMC (Redfish) for tests and demos

flags.name: fixture
flags.usage: embedded fixture name (generic, huawei-2288h-v5, supermicro-x12) or a path to a fixture YAML

flags.name: tls
flags.usage: serve HTTPS with an ephemeral self-signed certificate (what spec.address requires)

flags.name: verbose
flags.usage: log every request (default: only state-changing ones)

subcommands.name: fleet
subcommands.summary: serve a fleet of simulated BMCs from one file, with nothing, a virtual machine or a Talos container behind each

flags.name: config
flags.usage: fleet file (YAML): the machines, their BMC addresses, identities and backends

flags.name: hang-timeout
flags.usage: power-cycle a VM (up to three times per power-on) when its console shows only firmware screen control for this long after a power-on (0: never; not given: 1m30s under kvm, 3m0s under tcg)

flags.name: state-listen
flags.usage: address of the read-only state endpoint (plain HTTP, GET /state; "" serves none); keep it on loopback

flags.name: verbose
flags.usage: log every request (default: only state-changing ones)
